body:
Project Overview

The Anhui Tianda Petrochemical 300,000 TPA Polypropylene Project is a major petrochemical development located in Tianchang, Anhui Province, China. The project focuses on polypropylene production and associated chemical processing facilities.

The project involves specialized process equipment for impurity removal, absorption, and chemical washing operations, supporting the reliable operation of the polypropylene production facilities.

Project Highlights

  • Industry: Petrochemical & Polymer Production

  • Project Capacity: 300,000 Tons/Year

  • Key Equipment: Mixed Phenol Absorption Tower & Alkali Washing Tower

  • Process Applications: Impurity Removal, Gas Purification & Chemical Washing

  • Equipment Configuration: Customized Industrial Process Towers

Project Description and Tongyang's Role

TONGYANG played an important role in the equipment-related aspects of this project, contributing to engineering coordination, customized tower equipment solutions, manufacturing support, and technical implementation.

Our involvement focused on specialized absorption and alkali washing equipment, with attention to material compatibility, equipment configuration, fabrication requirements, and integration with the overall petrochemical process.

Through collaboration with the project engineering and technical teams, Tongyang supported the coordination and execution of complex process equipment requirements.

This project demonstrates Tongyang's capabilities in industrial tower manufacturing, petrochemical equipment solutions, and engineering collaboration for large-scale chemical processing facilities.
